title: Truth of a quantified prefix
statement: Let $m$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables, let $q_1,\ldots,q_r$ be a finite list of existential or universal quantifiers, and let $\sigma$ be a Boolean assignment with starting variable index $i$. The recursively quantified truth of $m$ under this prefix is equivalent to the truth obtained by applying the same prefix to the predicate that $m$ evaluates to true.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a CNF formula over natural-number variables
The quantifier prefix is a finite list of existential or universal quantifiers
$\sigma$ is a Boolean assignment to natural-number variables
The starting index $i$ is a natural number
